notes.title: 🦅 Official Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38492516/152e728584c69ae7e0767f71df957bae96fe3e61.jpg
大鹏已经远去，或者还在路上，现在它终于来了！

"大鹏 - The Roc" is our first game, a creation over more than four years.
Unlike popular campus romance stories, this is a prose novel about regret. Every time you think back on those most beautiful days, more and more details fade, leaving only persistent images that keep rearranging in your mind. Shattered dreams and lost love take on the label of youthful immaturity. But as these memories of youth and the pains of growing up are repeatedly intensified, we fantasize—if we could relive it all, would you and those once close to you finally fulfill your wishes? Be it a dream of literary fame or stardom, we hope this story stirs the ambitions you’ve buried deep in your heart. With limited resources and budget, perhaps we can’t fill every gap, and maybe it’s just a clumsy replay of what you'd rather not revisit. But hey, it’s all for fun—you might not laugh, but we do.

notes.title: [Demo Update] UI redesign, engine change, voice acting implementation
notes.notes:
After three years, for the update of the demo version, there is no additional viewable story content.

- Optimized the UI and engine
- Implemented voice acting for the three main heroines and some other characters
- Proofread the text, correcting typos and non-standard punctuation usage, and revising some awkward phrasing
- Changed some backgrounds, added one new CG that can be publicly released
